title: Andon reserved keys in a ledger issue
description: The keys Andon reserves in issues/<id>/issue.yaml, as readers take them from `kanban show <id> --json` (.issue). The ledger format allows and keeps any other key, so other keys are not checked here. The Chief of Staff writes these keys with `kanban set`, which stores every value as a string. A missing or unknown value is treated as missing by readers (the gate answers needs_human); keys with a default say so.

review.description: Whether an independent review is part of the issue. Missing: the gate answers needs_human and the dispatcher does not start a reviewer.

must_fix.description: Findings of this severity or heavier must be fixed by the issue's agent. Missing: the gate answers needs_human.

reviewer.description: Reviewer profile. Default: the other brand than the implementing profile (Claude -> codex-review, Codex -> claude-review).

review_rounds.description: Upper limit of review rounds, an integer of 1 or more written as a string (kanban set stores strings). Default: "2".

merge.description: auto: the dispatcher may merge after the gate approves, within the delegation. person: stop and notify the person. Default: person. It can only narrow the delegation.

machine.description: Machine name in the terminal host where the worker and reviewer run. Default: the same machine as the Chief of Staff.

deliverable.description: What the issue delivers. pr: a pull request (fix issues, Chief Engineer documents). candidates: library/candidates.json without a pull request (survey issues); andon issue ready asks for the file instead of a PR and the dispatcher does not run the gate. Default: pr.
